name: 小濱鷸
illustrationTaxon: Calidris minuta in non-breeding plumage, the plumage in which nearly all Hong Kong birds are seen: the smallest of the small waders at only 12-14 cm. Compared with Red-necked Stint it has longer and thinner legs, a more rounded body, a smaller head, a longer and more finely tipped bill, a more upright posture, slightly greater height and a more rapid foraging action; in non-breeding plumage these non-plumage features are critical to identification. The bill is fine, thin, black and almost straight; the legs are long, thin and dark. Non-breeding plumage is grey-brown above with neat pale feather fringes, a pale whitish supercilium and whitish underparts with only very faint grey streaking at the sides of the breast. Adult breeding plumage has warm brown fringes to the tertials, a pure white chin, throat and central chest, rusty rufous tones and extensive orange-brown in the wing coverts; juveniles are more contrasting than juvenile Red-necked Stints, with narrow white lines at the side of the mantle feathers and darker, more contrasting centres to the wing coverts and scapulars.

similarSpecies.distinction: 紅頸濱鷸頭較大、身體較矮圓而嘴短厚、站姿較低平；本種體型更小、頭小、嘴細長針狀、腳較長較細而站姿較挺，非繁殖羽時要靠這些體態特徵分辨。
青腳濱鷸腳為欖黃色、外側尾羽全白而尾較長；本種腳黑色、尾短、上體灰褐帶淺色羽緣，兩者都以小型與細嘴見長，但腳色一望即分。

featureNotes: 嘴黑色、細長如針、近乎筆直，比紅頸濱鷸的短厚嘴明顯纖細——這是本種最實用的辨識點（第1圈取自全身圖，實際可見）。
頭部相對身體明顯偏小，眉紋淡白，眼前有一道細細的深色眼紋（第2圈取自近景圖，實際可見）。
腳黑、細而長，比例上比紅頸濱鷸長，站起來整體顯得較高（第3圈取自全身圖，實際可見）。
站姿較挺、身體圓潤、尾部短——與紅頸濱鷸的低平蹲伏體態不同（第4圈取自全身圖，實際可見）。

sources.use: HKBWS substantive read: Category I, a scarce passage migrant in spring and rare in autumn and winter, occurring on the intertidal mudflats of Deep Bay and adjacent roost areas, with most birds seen at roost on Mai Po Nature Reserve or foraging on the Deep Bay mudflats and three records from commercial fish ponds at San Tin and one from the freshwater wetlands at Long Valley; 12-14 cm, and compared with Red-necked Stint it has longer and thinner legs, a more rounded body, a smaller head, a longer more finely-tipped bill, a more upright posture, slightly greater height and a more rapid foraging action, these non-plumage features being critical in non-breeding plumage; adult breeding plumage has warm brown fringes to the tertials, a pure white chin, throat and central chest, a rusty tone to the rufous colouration and extensive orange-brown in the wing coverts; juveniles compared with Red-necked Stint have narrow white lines at the side of the mantle feathers, darker and more contrasting centres to the wing coverts and scapulars, dark mottling at the side of the breast contrasting with a pale central area, a whiter supercilium, a darker central crown and a generally more contrasting appearance; the call is rarely heard among other shorebirds, a short high-pitched note uttered singly or in series; the first record was on 26 April 1986 since when it has occurred annually in very small numbers on spring passage and occasionally at other times of the year, with peak passage in the second half of April and extreme dates of 20 March and 8 June in spring and 5 August and 29 October in autumn, though there are fewer than ten records in autumn; there is one winter record on 13 December 2008; the highest count is six birds during 13-17 April 1990 and on 24 April 2003 and 25 April 2004; like Red-necked Stint with which it usually associates it prefers to forage on intertidal mudflats, pecking at the surface of the mud or probing just below; monotypic, breeding north of the Arctic Circle from northern Scandinavia east to the New Siberian Islands and wintering mainly in Africa but also coastally as far east as southeast Asia, and a rare passage migrant through much of China; IUCN Least Concern with an increasing population trend.

HKBWS Red-necked Stint comparison: a squat stint with a short thick bill, short neck and large head, the standard confusion species against which Little Stint's small head, fine bill, longer thinner legs and upright stance are judged.

HKBWS Temminck's Stint comparison: an equally small, fine-billed stint but with olive-yellow legs and a longer tail with white outer tail feathers, separating it from Little Stint's black legs and short tail.

notes: AI 生成插圖，經人眼核對細長針狀黑嘴、小頭淡眉、細長黑腳及挺立體態；描繪非繁殖羽（香港所見幾乎全為此羽色），未畫繁殖羽的橙褐肩羽。
兩隻比較鳥均為 AI 生成示意（紅頸濱鷸沿用 0147 全身圖、青腳濱鷸沿用 0144 全身圖），非等比例；卡上不作完整鑑別檢索表。
地圖為 Natural Earth 110m 世界底圖的國家層級概述，不是精確分佈多邊形，繁殖地與越冬地不分工。
IUCN 無危 LC（趨勢上升）；香港屬 Category I，春季稀少過境鳥、秋季與冬季罕見，最高 6 隻（1990-04-13 至 17、2003-04-24、2004-04-25）。
